{{Quote|You know how someone seems a little less human when they lose people they love? A little more like a zombie?|Han Solo|<ref name="Hero for Hire">''[[Star Wars Journal: Hero for Hire]]''</ref>}}
A '''zombie''', also referred to as the '''undead''', was the corpse of a [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] or non-sentient creature that had been reanimated from the [[Death/Legends|dead]] as a mindless and violent being.

==History==
Through [[Sith alchemy/Legends|Sith alchemy]] the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] were able to create [[Korriban zombie]]s as guardians of the [[Valley of the Dark Lords/Legends|Valley of the Dark Lords]].<ref name="TotJ3">[[Tales of the Jedi – Dark Lords of the Sith 3|''Tales of the Jedi – Dark Lords of the Sith'' 3]]</ref> [[Sith undead]] were also to be found guarding the [[Dark Force Temple]] on [[Dromund Kaas/Legends|Dromund Kaas]].<ref name="MOTS">''[[Star Wars: Jedi Knight: Mysteries of the Sith]]''</ref>

In 4645 BBY, on the ice-blanketed world of [[Odacer-Faustin]] the Sith Lord, [[Darth Drear]] established the [[Odacer-Faustin Sith academy|Odacer-Faustin Sith Academy]] in hopes of achieving [[Immortality/Legends|Immortality]] through the use of a complex Sith alchemical formula for an elixir more akin to a virus and specific rituals. He died however soon after attempting the rituals while self-infected with his virus-like elixir aka, [[Imperial bioweapons Project I71A|"the Sickness"]].<ref name="Harvest">[[Red Harvest (novel)|''Red Harvest'']]</ref>

The [[Rakghoul plague/Legends|Rakghoul plague]] was able to turn beings into mindless creatures similar to zombies.<ref name="KotOR">''[[Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic]]''</ref>

During the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] in 3645 BBY, Sith Lord [[Darth Scabrous|Scabrous]] planned to use Drear's elixir and rituals to attain what his predecessor could not, eternal life. Despite using all the ingredients required including the [[Murakami orchid]], he and the entire academy's student body, faculty and staff save for one dockhand, [[Pergus Frode]] all fell victim the Sith-created virus that turned them into cannibalistic undead.<ref name="Harvest" />

The [[Zelosian]] people believed that zombies existed on [[Zelos II|their planet]]. That particular phenomenon was later attributed to [[Jumper|parasitic worms]] infesting corpses and causing zombie-like movement.

Zombies were known to be used by the [[Energy Vampire|energy vampire]] [[Rajine]], who utilized their services against trespassers and as palace help. Although it is unknown whether this effect would be had upon all zombies, Rajine's minions were [[Words of banishment|turned against]] her using [[Samuro]]'s [[Samuro's Jedi holocron|Jedi holocron]].<ref name="NWO">{{CWACite|9|No Way Out}}</ref>

[[File:Reanimated_Rancor_TSS_by_Shoemaker.jpg|thumb|left|190px|A reanimated [[Rancor/Legends|rancor]]]]
During the [[Second Battle of Geonosis/Legends|Second Battle of Geonosis]], the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Luminara Unduli/Legends|Luminara Unduli]] and [[Clone trooper/Legends|trooper]] [[Buzz/Legends|Buzz]], while in search for [[Archduke/Legends|Archduke]] [[Poggle the Lesser/Legends|Poggle the Lesser]], entered the [[Progate Temple/Legends|Progate Temple]] during a sand storm and disappeared. [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] and [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] were sent to investigate with a squad of clone troopers lead by [[Clone Commander/Legends|Commander]] [[Cody/Legends|Cody]]. They found [[Geonosian/Legends|Geonosians]] controlled by a hive mind that was so strong, it could resurrect dead warriors, similar to zombies. This was achieved by using [[Brain worm/Legends|worms]] that controlled the bodies, while [[Karina the Great/Legends|Karina the Great]] was the controller.<ref name="LOT">{{TCW|Legacy of Terror}}</ref>

During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], [[Mother (title)/Legends|Mother]] [[Talzin/Legends|Talzin]] and the [[Nightsisters/Legends|Nightsisters]] kept a [[Army of the Dead/Legends|group]] of undead individuals that helped the Nightsisters during the [[Battle of Dathomir/Legends|Battle of Dathomir]].<ref name="Massacre">{{TCW|Massacre}}</ref>

The [[darkstaff]], an ancient [[Sith artifact/Legends|Sith artifact]], had the power to reanimate corpses and turn them into [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side]]-wielding zombies. In about [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]], the [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Len Markus]] used the staff to suck the Force essences out of the [[Force Adept]]s [[San Herrera]] and [[Nia Reston]], then turn their cadavers into zombies. The two zombies attacked a group of [[Heroes of Cularin|freelance agents]] in the jungles of the planet [[Cularin/Legends|Cularin]], and the agents were eventually able to defeat the undead pair.<ref name="The Eye">{{LivingForce|EndTimes: The Eye}}</ref>
[[File:Zombie_trooper.jpg|thumb|A reanimated Stormtrooper]]
Around [[1 BBY/Legends|1 BBY]] an Imperial biological weapons project had been tasked with engineering a virus, under the codename of [[Imperial bioweapons Project I71A|Blackwing]]. The virus seemed to turn almost any being, living or dead, who came in contact with it to a mindless flesh-craving undead creature. These creatures seemed to possess only primitive feral instincts after being turned, but were able to communicate and learn from each other through what seemed like unintelligible screeching. They were also capable of operating machinery and handling weapons, such as [[Blaster/Legends|blasters]], and were even able to pilot ships, such as [[X-wing starfighter/Legends|X-Wings]] and [[TIE/ln space superiority starfighter/Legends|TIE Fighters]]. The two known outbreaks that occurred during this time were on the [[Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyer]], [[Vector (Star Destroyer)|''Vector'']] where Blackwing had been reintroduced to sentient hosts, causing the vessel and its former crew to drift in deep space. Ten weeks after the outbreak, the Imperial prison barge [[Purge (prison barge)|''Purge'']] that had experienced engine malfunction docked to the ''Vector'' and sent two teams to search for engine parts to repair their ship and move on. Soon after the virus infected nearly the entire population of the barge, crew and inmates with a few survivors forced to escape onto the larger vessel. After a series of close calls and more deaths, the survivors escaped the Star Destroyer via a [[Dropship/Legends|drop shuttle]].<ref name="Death Troopers">''[[Death Troopers]]''</ref>

After the ''Vector'' incident, the Blackwing project was relocated to a secret [[Imperial Research and Prison Facility]] on the planet [[Dathomir/Legends|Dathomir]]. However, after the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], an [[Blackwing virus outbreak on Dathomir|accident]] happened in the Imperial Research and Prison Facility and the virus escaped containment another time. The Empire created the [[Quarantine Zone (Dathomir)|Quarantine Zone]] to contain the infection.<ref name="SWG:MMR">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=general|Mysterious Meeting Request|Dathomir}}</ref>

Shortly after the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], [[Cornelius Evazan/Legends|Cornelius Evazan]], working on the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Empire's]] [[Project Starscream]], performed experiments in reanimating the dead on [[Necropolis (Core Worlds)|Necropolis]]. He developed a successful resurrection serum which allowed him to return to life after he was killed by [[Boba Fett/Legends|Boba Fett]].<ref name="City of the Dead">''[[Galaxy of Fear: City of the Dead]]''</ref>

{{Talesstart}}
[[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] and [[Chewbacca/Legends|Chewbacca]] once visited an [[Unidentified planet (blue-skinned race)|uncharted planet]] which was haunted by dead, living skeletal figures. These zombies were once the 1,000 crew members of a [[Great Interplanetary Ark]] that had crashed on the planet some time before. The souls would haunt the villagers every night, because they never made the land. However, Solo laid down two lines of [[tandgor gem]]s to light a runway for the ghostly form of the Great Interplanetary Ark to land, finally putting the souls to rest.<ref name="POTD">{{Tales|17|Planet of the Dead}}</ref>

{{Talesend}}

[[File:Deathtrooperconcept.jpg|thumb|right|200px|Zombie [[Stormtrooper/Legends|Stormtrooper]] concept art for the ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'' [[Death Troopers]] update.]]

==Behind the Scenes==
[[Adam Nichols]] created concept design artwork of a Zombie [[Jedi]] for the [[Krome Studios]] port of the [[2008]] video game ''[[Star Wars: The Force Unleashed]]'', depicted alongside a pair of [[Force ghost/Legends|Force Ghost]] Jedi. According to him, the developers tried programming the enemy but it went unused in the final game. <ref>{{WebCite|url=https://www.adamnichols.net/star_wars.php|text=Star Wars - The Force Unleashed|author=Adam Nichols|quote=Zombie Jedi Concept Design.|archivedate=20250406203411}}</ref>
